subject: a nocturnal moth with a radio-dial thorax
pose: wings partly folded around a central dial
art_direction: 夜蛾的胸部是一枚无字收音旋钮，蓝绿翅片夹着琥珀透光线，形成神秘但友善的中心角色。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a nocturnal moth whose thorax is a single blank radio tuning dial, with no numbers or letters. Its teal enamel wings fold partly around the amber-lit dial like a compact cloak, while two short antennae curve inward. Keep the head small with calm dark eyes, giving the creature an attentive rather than eerie presence. Fine copper traces follow the wing veins, but the overall wing shapes remain broad and readable. Use a deep midnight-blue background with one restrained violet rim light. Render enamel depth, thin metal edges, and warm light passing through the dial. Center the moth at seventy-five percent of the square, with no star field or surrounding gadgets.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
